categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the freshly-made drinks industry, offering value-for-money freshly-made fruit drinks, tea drinks, ice cream, and coffee. It has two major brands: Mixue (freshly-made tea drinks) and Lucky Cup (freshly-made coffee). The business model is mainly franchise-based, with a small number of self-operated stores.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes a highly digitalized end-to-end supply chain with 100% self-produced core ingredients. It operates centralized factories across multiple production bases in China, employing proprietary R&D for product flavors, ingredient technologies, production techniques, and equipment. It also developed a proprietary fresh milk blend base production technique to enhance product quality and health attributes. The logistics system is self-operated with extensive warehousing and distribution networks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are mass-market consumers seeking high-quality, affordable freshly-made drinks. The company serves consumers through over 46,000 franchised stores across China and 11 overseas countries, targeting all city tiers including first-tier to third-tier and below cities. The products appeal broadly to consumers valuing value-for-money and quality in freshly-made beverages.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations cover mainland China extensively, with stores in 31 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities, spanning over 300 cities. It also has a growing presence internationally with approximately 4,900 stores in 11 overseas countries, focusing on Southeast Asia and expanding into other global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the supply chain by self-producing core ingredients and managing centralized factories. It also controls logistics and distribution networks, providing a one-stop supply solution to franchisees. The downstream point is the franchised stores operated by franchisees selling the final products to consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding store networks domestically and internationally, enhancing the end-to-end supply chain breadth and depth, and investing in production capacity and logistics efficiency. R&D focuses on both application (product flavors and recipes) and fundamental research (ingredient technologies, production processes, and equipment). The company also emphasizes digitalization and intelligentization of operations and aims to develop its brand IP 'Snow King' into a global cultural symbol.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily from sales of goods and equipment to franchisees and stores, with a smaller portion from franchise and related service fees (2.5% of revenue in 2024). The franchisees purchase supplies and equipment from the company and operate stores under the company’s brands.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a global leading freshly-made drinks company with a large store network and strong brand presence. It differentiates itself through its extensive franchise model, highly efficient and digitalized supply chain, and unique brand IP. Specific competitors are not named, but the company claims to have a leading position in mainland China and is expanding overseas.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company has shown strong financial growth with revenue increasing from RMB10.35 billion in 2021 to RMB24.83 billion in 2024, representing a CAGR of over 30%. Profit for the year grew by nearly 40% from RMB3.19 billion in 2023 to RMB4.45 billion in 2024. Total assets reached RMB19.78 billion with a gearing ratio of 23.9%. The company was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange Main Board in March 2025.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes providing high-quality, freshly-made drinks at affordable prices (around RMB6 per item), supported by a proprietary, vertically integrated supply chain ensuring product quality and cost efficiency. Its unique brand IP 'Snow King' enhances emotional connection and brand loyalty. The franchise model aligns interests with franchisees, supported by digitalized operations and standardized management, enabling rapid and sustainable expansion.
